name: PayBox
logo_rule: Keep the original black-and-white tile. Never recolour it.
one_liner: An AI payment vault that lets Claude and ChatGPT prepare transactions, while you approve each one with a passkey.
facts: Launched 29 July 2026 by MoonPay; connects to Claude and ChatGPT as a connector
Prompt, approve, pay: the agent prepares, you approve with a passkey, then funds move
Modes: Always Ask (passkey every transaction) and Autonomous (spending limit; changing it needs a passkey; revocable)
Keys split with MPC across TEEs; neither MoonPay nor the AI can sign alone; each approval covers one action
Supports swaps, bridging, DeFi, x402 paid services, bookings and shopping
Launch chains: Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Hyperliquid, Tempo, Robinhood Chain
safe_claims: Nothing moves until you approve (Always Ask mode)
avoid_claims: Every action uses the same approval flow
Chains beyond the launch list without checking (e.g. BNB)
